title: Sega Ages: I Love Mickey Mouse: Fushigi no Oshiro Daibouken & I Love Donald Duck: Georgia Ou no Hihou
native_title: セガエイジス アイ・ラブ・ミッキー・マウス ～ふしぎのお城 大冒険～ ／ アイ・ラブ・ドナルド・ダック ～グルジア王の秘宝～
overview:
Love and courage, thrills and action - a deluxe double feature!

Two Disney side-scrolling action games, originally made for the Mega Drive, together on one disc.

I Love Mickey Mouse: Fushigi no Oshiro Daibouken - The jealous witch Mizrabel has carried Minnie off to the Castle of Illusion. Guide Mickey through a world of dreams and adventure, bouncing on enemies and throwing apples and marbles, and win the Seven Gems of Rainbow from the Masters of Illusion to reach the witch's tower.

I Love Donald Duck: Georgia Ou no Hihou - An old map points the way to the hidden treasure of King Garuzia, and Pete is after it too. Fly with your nephews from place to place, explore each area and its dungeon, solve clues and blast enemies with a gun that fires plungers, popcorn and bubble gum.

For 1 player.

愛と勇気、スリルとアクション、豪華2本立て！
